cohort: Twenty patients who had undergone reduction mammaplasty and subsequently conceived and delivered at the study institution.
finding: The ability to breastfeed was not significantly affected by a history of breast reduction surgery, regardless of pedicle type, tissue excision weight, or demographic factors, although delivering a small for gestational age infant significantly reduced the chance of breastfeeding success.
mod_finding: Delivery method was not significantly associated with breastfeeding success.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was measured and analyzed as an exposure; delivering a small for gestational age infant significantly reduced breastfeeding success.
gest_age: Gestational age (preterm delivery, small for gestational age) was measured and analyzed as an exposure; delivering a small for gestational age infant significantly reduced breastfeeding success.
